purpose: Fresh two-agent MAPPO base-policy training on a comprehensive, non-adversarial Town05 curriculum covering free flow, parallel driving, same-lane following, closing risk, near-gap recovery and required merging in four directions.

parameter_rationale.scenario_design: Eight balanced families across four directions cover independent cruising, stationary and rolling parallel driving, steady following, same-lane closing, cross-lane closing, near-gap recovery and required merging. Every generated scenario is non-adversarial; later adversarial training remains responsible for constructing malicious behavior.
parameter_rationale.curriculum_design: Metadata difficulty creates cumulative stages. D1 contains free-flow and stationary parallel launch; D2 adds rolling parallel and steady following; D3 adds closing interactions; D4 adds near-gap recovery and required merging. New stages enter with a ten-update soft weight ramp and earlier skills remain sampled.
parameter_rationale.perception_design: The 19-dimensional observation shape is preserved, but the eleven normalized all-round rays use a registered 20 m physical range so safe 8-10 m following starts are observable. TTC candidates use the same 20 m horizon.
parameter_rationale.optimization: The signed-longitudinal action protocol, reward v3, AgentConditionedCritic, ValueNorm and PPO settings remain unchanged. A 160-update pilot and slower curriculum provide enough exposure for twice as many scenario families.
parameter_rationale.migration_boundary: Town05 v1 and Town02 results remain historical evidence. The changed scenario pool and lidar normalization require a fresh Town05 v2 run; old checkpoints and optimizer/RNG states cannot resume into this contract.
parameter_rationale.seed_policy: Seed 42 is the engineering pilot. Additional seeds remain blocked until the Town05 v2 milestone and held-out capability gates are frozen and passed.
